# Calculus and Optimisation for Machine Learning

> Differentiate by hand and in code, build a small reverse-mode engine, and train models with gradient descent you can diagnose. SDAIA Academy course FND-MTH-102, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 18,577 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Week 1: Change and approximation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week1.md): Derivatives as local linear approximations, and three ways to compute one; sessions: Derivatives as local lines; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week1.html; about 2,911 tokens
- [Week 2: Several variables](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week2.md): Partial derivatives, gradients and Jacobians, and how to check them; sessions: Gradients and Jacobians; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week2.html; about 2,207 tokens
- [Week 3: The chain rule on graphs](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week3.md): Computational graphs, forward and reverse mode, and a backward pass by hand; sessions: Graphs and the chain rule; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week3.html; about 2,168 tokens
- [Week 4: Reverse mode in code](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week4.md): The chain rule with vectors and matrices, and a small automatic differentiation engine; sessions: A reverse-mode engine; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week4.html; about 2,108 tokens
- [Week 5: Gradient descent](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week5.md): Step size, stochastic gradients, momentum and reading loss curves; sessions: Descent and loss curves; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week5.html; about 2,251 tokens
- [Week 6: The shape of a loss](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week6.md): Convexity, saddle points, curvature and the largest stable step; sessions: Convexity and curvature; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week6.html; about 2,091 tokens
- [Week 7: Stable losses and penalties](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week7.md): Log-sum-exp, softmax cross-entropy and regularisation as a penalty; sessions: Stable losses and penalties; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week7.html; about 1,924 tokens
- [Week 8: Constraints](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week8.md): Lagrange multipliers, projected gradients and the price of a constraint; sessions: Constraints and prices; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/week8.html; about 1,930 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone oral checks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/capstone.md): A two-layer network trained with your own engine, defended in ten minutes with the questions inside them; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/slides/capstone.html; about 825 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Three ways to a derivative](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W1_1_derivatives.ipynb): Week 1, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 2.1: Gradients and a Jacobian, checked](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W2_1_gradients.ipynb): Week 2, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 3.1: Backpropagation by hand](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W3_1_backprop_by_hand.ipynb): Week 3, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 4.1: A scalar reverse-mode engine](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W4_1_autodiff_engine.ipynb): Week 4, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 5.1: Learning-rate sweeps](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W5_1_lr_sweeps.ipynb): Week 5, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 6.1: Six loss surfaces](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W6_1_loss_surfaces.ipynb): Week 6, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 7.1: Stable softmax and a penalty](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W7_1_stable_softmax.ipynb): Week 7, Session 1, 105 min
- [Lab 8.1: A budget allocation two ways](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-mth-102/labs/W8_1_budget_allocation.ipynb): Week 8, Session 1, 105 min
